Request for Proposal to Provide Audit Services for the  
William Marsh Rice University Defined Contribution Retirement Plan 
 
INTRODUCTION  
Rice University (“the University”) requests a proposal to provide external audit services for the 
William Marsh Rice University Defined Contribution and Supplemental 403(b) Retirement 
Plans, as required under Department of Labor regulations. As more fully described in this 
memorandum, you should submit a written proposal outlining your firm’s qualifications, 
approach, and fees for this work.  
 
It is the practice of the University to appoint or reappoint a plan auditor on an annual basis. 
However, the University expects a continuing relationship with the firm selected and will
